dedupe_keys.name: altitude by geotab aggregate commercial vehicle movement intelligence north america

description: Geotab is a fleet telematics company whose platform connects commercial vehicle fleets; its Altitude product turns billions of anonymised trips from connected vehicles into aggregate, historical movement intelligence for planners. Coverage: commercial vehicle movement across North America; Altitude is used by state agencies, infrastructure planners, utilities and data platforms, for example by DOTs and MPOs to prioritise freight corridors, by utilities to model electric vehicle charging demand from vehicle miles travelled, trip density and idling, by traffic engineers to assess congestion and pavement stress from heavy vehicle volumes, and by site selection teams, consultants and GIS platforms for commercial traffic flows, bottlenecks and parking demand; Geotab's smart city analytics cover road conditions, collision-prone areas and emissions for cities. Format and access: aggregated, de-identified data at geographic and temporal resolutions chosen for planning, not real-time tracking, delivered as data products and through platform integrations; brochure and sales contact; Geotab states FIPS 140-3 validation and FedRAMP certification for security. Licence: commercial; not read. Caveats: Altitude represents vehicles on Geotab devices, so the sample reflects its fleet customers; exact metrics, resolutions and prices were not read. Simulation uses: observed freight and commercial vehicle flows for road network flow and freight corridor models, EV charging capacity planning and pavement deterioration studies. Related records: Replica trip tables (data-replica-seasonal-trip-tables-and-network-volumes-us) and TomTom traffic analytics (data-tomtom-maps-traffic-and-move-portal).
